title: fix(components): every wide centred dialog reads one shared viewport gutter (objectui#12603)
body:
Fixes #12603
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

One shared rule for the viewport gutter of every wide centred dialog. `ModalForm`'s private `BOUNDED_SIZE_VIEWPORT_GUTTER` (PR #12598) is promoted to one export of `@object-ui/components`: `DIALOG_VIEWPORT_GUTTER = 'sm:w-[calc(100%-2rem)]'`, in the new module `packages/components/src/custom/dialog-viewport-gutter.ts`, re-exported through `custom/index.ts`. Every wide `DialogContent` now writes its cap and this constant together, and nothing spells the gutter literal of its own.

- From `sm` up the dialog is the smaller of its max width and the window less 2rem. The primitive's `left-[50%]` / `translate-x-[-50%]` centres it, so it keeps 1rem either side.
- Above its max width plus 2rem each dialog is exactly as wide as before.
- The Shadcn-synced primitive `packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx` is not edited.

**Sites:**

- `app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx` `SIZE_CLASS`: `lg` and `xl` (the size a page-target modal with no size opens at). `full`, `sm`, `default` and `SIDE_SIZE_CLASS` (the sheet) are unchanged.
- `app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx` (long list), `FlowRunner.tsx` (object form or long screen), `metadata-admin/CelTestRunDialog.tsx`.
- `components/src/custom/fullscreen-editor.tsx`.
- `fields/src/widgets/RecordPickerDialog.tsx`: an unconditional `cn()` argument, so every column-count rung reads it, the `lg:max-w-5xl` ceiling included. Below `sm` it stays `95vw`.
- `fields/src/widgets/ImageLightbox.tsx`: measured in the family (below).
- `plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`.
- `plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx` reads the export instead of its private copy. Its class output is byte-identical.

**Census** `packages/components/src/__tests__/dialogViewportGutterCensus-12603.test.ts` (7 tests):

- It reads every `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` source file whose comment-masked text (`scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`) names `DialogContent`.
- It follows each `DialogContent` / `MobileDialogContent` `className` through the TypeScript AST: `cn()` arguments, conditionals, same-file consts and maps, and same-file function returns.
- A breakpoint cap is WIDE when a window at that breakpoint cannot hold it with 1rem a side: `sm:` above 608px, `lg:` above 992px, and so on. A cap it cannot size fails closed.
- `WIDE_SITES` declares every wide centred dialog. Declared and found must agree, and each must read the gutter: a template literal that interpolates `DIALOG_VIEWPORT_GUTTER` beside the cap, or the constant as an unconditional `cn()` argument.
- `OWN_GUTTER` is deletions-only. It holds one site, below.
- Sheets are never judged.

**Runtime pins:**

- `app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useActionModal.viewportGutter-12603.test.tsx` (4 tests): `xl` and `lg` read the gutter. CONTROLs: `full` keeps `sm:max-w-[95vw] sm:w-full`, `default` reads none, and a `side` placement (sheet) reads none.
- `fields/src/widgets/RecordPickerDialog.viewportGutter-12603.test.tsx` (2 tests): the widest rung (six columns, `sm:max-w-3xl lg:max-w-5xl`) and the narrowest carry it. `w-[95vw]` stays for below `sm`.

## Mechanism assumptions, as measured

- **A1, the record picker across both breakpoints: holds after the change.** The premise that it ran edge to edge does NOT hold on `main`: its own `w-[95vw]` kept a 2.5vw margin (16px at 640, 19.2px at 768, 25.6px at 1024). Under the one rule it now reads the shared gutter like the rest: 16px at every width from `sm` up to the cap, and unchanged above the cap plus 2rem. The widest case is pinned.
- **A2, Clause-②: yes.** Promoting the token adds a new named export, `DIALOG_VIEWPORT_GUTTER`, to the `@object-ui/components` package entry. That is a widening, so the changeset declares `@object-ui/components` `minor`, and each other touched package `patch`. The second line of this body is corrected to `yes`.
- **The class is still emitted.** I ran the console's own Tailwind step: `@tailwindcss/postcss` over `apps/console/src/index.css`, whose `@source` lines cover `packages/components/src`. The emitted sheet carries `.sm\:w-\[calc\(100\%-2rem\)\] { width: calc(100% - 2rem) }` inside the `sm` media query. After this change the only tracked non-test source that spells the class is `components/src/custom/dialog-viewport-gutter.ts`, so the rule comes from there.
- **`ImageLightbox` is in the family.** Its `sm:max-w-4xl` replaces the `92vw` from `sm` up. Measured with a 3000px-wide image, before: 768 gives 768 · 0/0 and 640 gives 640 · 0/0, edge to edge. After: 736 · 16/16 and 608 · 16/16. Folded in.

## Real-layout reading (headless Chromium 1194, static harness)

Each class list is the primitive's class string merged with the site's class through `tailwind-merge`, as `cn` does, over the console's emitted CSS. The viewport height is 900. Each cell is width · left/right gutter in px, before → after.

| Viewport | action modal `xl` | `lg` / `CelTestRunDialog` | `3xl` sites (param list, flow, editor) | `4xl` sites (import wizard, lightbox image) | record picker, six columns |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1440 | 1024 · 208/208 → same | 672 · 384/384 → same | 768 · 336/336 → same | 896 · 272/272 → same | 1024 · 208/208 → same |
| 1100 | 1024 · 38/38 → same | 672 · 214/214 → same | 768 · 166/166 → same | 896 · 102/102 → same | 1024 · 38/38 → same |
| 1024 | 1024 · 0/0 → 992 · 16/16 | 672 · 176/176 → same | 768 · 128/128 → same | 896 · 64/64 → same | 972.8 · 25.6/25.6 → 992 · 16/16 |
| 900 | 900 · 0/0 → 868 · 16/16 | 672 · 114/114 → same | 768 · 66/66 → same | 896 · 2/2 → 868 · 16/16 | 768 · 66/66 → same |
| 768 | 768 · 0/0 → 736 · 16/16 | 672 · 48/48 → same | 768 · 0/0 → 736 · 16/16 | 768 · 0/0 → 736 · 16/16 | 729.6 · 19.2/19.2 → 736 · 16/16 |
| 700 | 700 · 0/0 → 668 · 16/16 | 672 · 14/14 → 668 · 16/16 | 700 · 0/0 → 668 · 16/16 | 700 · 0/0 → 668 · 16/16 | 665 · 17.5/17.5 → 668 · 16/16 |
| 640 | 640 · 0/0 → 608 · 16/16 | 640 · 0/0 → 608 · 16/16 | 640 · 0/0 → 608 · 16/16 | 640 · 0/0 → 608 · 16/16 | 608 · 16/16 → same |
| 390 | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged |

CONTROLs, identical before and after at every viewport: the action modal's `full` (1368 · 36/36 at 1440, 608 · 16/16 at 640) and `default` (512 wide).

## Tests and gates

The heavy runs went through the shared verify lock. CI runs the full farm.

- **New and touched pins:** the census (7 tests), the action modal pin (4) and the picker pin (2) all pass.
- **Package suites:**
  - `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/`: Test Files 389 passed, 1 skipped (390). Tests 3926 passed, 24 skipped (3950).
  - `packages/fields/`: Test Files 258 passed, 1 skipped (259). Tests 4086 passed, 7 skipped (4093).
  - `packages/plugin-form/`: Test Files 187 passed (187). Tests 2291 passed, 1 skipped (2292).
  - `packages/plugin-grid/`: Test Files 217 passed (217). Tests 2018 passed (2018).
  - All four ran at `5bfde250b`.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, narrowed (declared):** the full `packages/app-shell/` run (1434 test files) was stopped before it took the lock, because it would have held the shared lock for most of an hour with other seats queued. In its place, 126 files ran at `5bfde250b` and passed: Test Files 126 passed (126), Tests 1127 passed (1127). They are every app-shell test that names `useActionModal`, `ActionParamDialog`, `FlowRunner` or `CelTestRunDialog` (`git grep -l`), plus the package's ratchet and census tests (`product-neutral-renderer`, `no-component-any-cast`, `actions-envelope`, `flow-envelope` and the rest). The blind spot: a test that renders one of these dialogs without naming its module is not in the set. CI runs the whole package.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` exited 0 (28 tasks). Then `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) for components, app-shell, fields, plugin-grid and plugin-form exited 0. `--listFilesOnly` confirms that each test tsconfig compiles its new pin.
- **ESLint** on the 14 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config`): 0 errors. The new files carry no warnings. Every warning on the touched files is a pre-existing `no-explicit-any` / `react-hooks` warning on lines this diff does not touch.
- **Pre-tsc battery, each exit 0:** `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, and `node scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`.
- **Changeset gates, each exit 0:** `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence` (14 source files of 5 released packages, 1 changeset declared), `check-changeset-no-major`. Also `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:test-path-roots`.
- **Governed surface:** `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 15 paths answers NOT GOVERNED.

## Ablation

The fix was committed first. `ablation-replace` mutated the action modal's `xl` entry from the template with the gutter to the bare `'sm:max-w-5xl'`, with a trapped restore. On disk the anchor count went from 1 to 0, and the blob changed from `c02389544865` to `ee8915849adb`.

- The census went red: `every listed wide dialog reads the shared gutter` named `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx · DialogContent · sm:max-w-2xl sm:max-w-5xl`.
- The runtime pin went red: `xl, the size a page target with no size opens at, reads the gutter beside its cap`.
- Every other test stayed green: Tests 2 failed, 9 passed (11).
- After the restore, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **The census threshold is geometric, not "above `lg`" taken literally.** A `sm:max-w-xl` (576px) or `sm:max-w-[560px]` dialog keeps at least 32px a side in the narrowest `sm` window, so it is never in this defect. The census counts a cap as wide only when a window at its breakpoint cannot hold it with 1rem a side. All the card's enumerated sites are caught, and one more as well (next note).
- **One wide dialog keeps a gutter of its own and is frozen in `OWN_GUTTER`.** It is `components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`'s modal mode: `w-[calc(100vw-1rem)]` under a host-set `--ov-w` cap, 42rem by default. It is never edge to edge, but it is a 0.5rem literal of its own. It was outside the card's enumeration and this PR's file surface, so it is not converged here. Carrier: none.
- **The record picker gets slightly wider between `sm` and its cap.** It used `95vw`, and is now the window less 2rem: for example 736px instead of 729.6px at 768. That is the one rule replacing a per-site margin.
- **Not covered by the census:** a `className` that arrives from outside the file (a prop, `schema.className`), an inline `style` width, and a wrapper that renders a `DialogContent` under another tag name. Each is stated in the census header.
- No docs page states these dialog widths, so no docs edit.

Implemented by the os-dev run in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`.
